summary: Frontend-only verification of new Silverstone circuit orbit/camera/postprocessing rework and chapter-stepping regressions. All 12 review scenarios pass across desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844), reduced-motion emulation, deep link + Back-to-Circuit, theme switching, keyboard/wheel/touch stepping and Explore menu navigation. Zero JS/console errors (only the ignorable GPU/THREE warnings). No functional bugs found.
verified_flows: Preloader boots and is skippable with Enter; [data-testid='silverstone-circuit-map'] present; .circuit-viewport data-active='top' at hero.

Hero -> circuit hub via mouse.wheel(0,120): after ~6s .circuit-viewport has data-active='circuit', data-traveling='false', map has data-orbitable='true', circuit-orbit-hint has is-visible with text 'DRAG TO ORBIT · CTRL + SCROLL TO ZOOM'. All 11 chapter-marker-* button pins have inline style opacity='1' and pointer-events='auto' (the additional 11 chapter-marker-*-content elements are inner spans without inline style — expected).

Manual orbit drag @ (960,420) with 20 x +15px steps: mid-drag data-dragging='true', on release data-dragging is cleared, data-active stays 'circuit', orbit hint loses 'is-visible' after the first drag, chapter-marker-legacy rect moves dx~31 dy~38 (camera rotated).

Pin click after fresh circuit landing: [data-testid='chapter-marker-cars'] -> data-active='cars' with data-traveling='false' within ~1s; back-to-circuit-button visible. Additional pins verified: gallery, records, victories, legacy all land on their respective chapter.

Back to Circuit from cars: data-overview='true', data-active='circuit', canvas data-orbitable='true', pins opacity=1 (all 11), circuit-coverage-label contains 'TRACK COVERED · 20% · CURRENT POSITION / CARS' (dynamic).

Ctrl+wheel zoom in overview (2x -400 deltaY): window.devicePixelRatio 1->1 unchanged, document.documentElement.clientWidth 1920->1920 unchanged (browser zoom NOT triggered), pin-distance legacy<->cars 124->225px (spread further apart, zoomed in), data-active stays 'circuit', data-overview stays 'true', hint hides.
Plain wheel step from overview closes data-overview (goes to false).
Keyboard ArrowDown/ArrowUp still steps chapters (circuit -> legacy -> circuit).
Theme switch (Mercedes then McLaren) while on circuit: no console errors, canvas & pins still present, data-active still 'circuit'.

Mobile 390x844 (CDP touch events): (a) horizontal drag +180px x with ~12 moves: data-active stays 'circuit', orbit hint loses is-visible. (b) vertical upward swipe -126px y: data-active='legacy' after ~8s. document.documentElement.scrollWidth = 390 (no horizontal overflow).
Deep link #route-cars + preloader-skip: data-active='cars' after settle, BTC visible, clicking BTC -> data-overview='true', data-active='circuit', all 11 pins opacity=1, no console errors.
Explore menu -> navigation-gallery-button click: data-active='gallery', lap counter reads 'SECTOR 04 / 11'.

Reduced-motion emulation (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) on #route-circuit: canvas renders, 11 pins present, chapter-marker-cars click still navigates to 'cars', back-to-circuit-button click still returns to 'circuit'.
Console: 0 JavaScript errors across all flows (excluding ignorable GPU/THREE.Clock warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: chapter-marker-* selector matches both the pin <button> and its inner .chapter-marker-*-content wrapper (22 matches for 11 pins). Not a bug, but tests should target `[data-testid^='chapter-marker-']:not([data-testid$='-content'])` to isolate the 11 real markers.
orbit hint 'is-visible' toggles off on any drag, ctrl-wheel or after touch-move. Behavior is per spec; consider adding a subtle re-appearance after long idle to help discoverability.

Post-BTC overview shows all pin opacity=1 immediately, but data-orbitable is true and hint starts hidden (only re-shown after idle timer). Spec said 'hint visible again' — right now the hint reappears via the ~4s idle auto-orbit timer, not immediately. If E1 wanted immediate re-show, they should reset hintSeen flag inside openCircuitOverview().
context_for_next_testing_agent: For circuit orbit testing: use window.__hamiltonLenis.scrollTo for programmatic scroll (NOT window.scrollTo); window.__spatialGo(key) navigates directly; window.__spatialStep(1|-1) steps chapters. In headless mode chapter travel takes 5-8s (not the 1.25s of real rendering) so use >=8s waits after wheel/pin clicks. Pin selector: use `[data-testid^='chapter-marker-']:not([data-testid$='-content'])` for the 11 button pins. To detect real drag vs click, check [data-testid='silverstone-circuit-map'] data-dragging attribute mid-gesture. Ctrl+wheel zoom is verified NOT to trigger browser zoom (dpr and clientWidth stable). Mobile touch events must go via CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent, not page.touchscreen.
